risks.title: Regulatory Non-Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to numerous federal and state laws and regulations, and non-compliance could result in fines, penalties, and reputational damage. The language used in the report is strong and emphasizes the importance of compliance.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The bank's concentration in commercial real estate (CRE) loans is high, which could increase credit risk. The bank has a CRE loan to capital ratio of 237%, which is below the 300% threshold.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces cybersecurity risks, particularly due to the collection and processing of personal data. A security breach could result in reputational damage and significant costs.

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory non-compliance or a security breach could damage the company's reputation. Reputation is critical to attracting and retaining customers.

risks.title: Tax Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to changes in tax laws and regulations, which could impact financial results. Recent changes, such as the Inflation Reduction Act, could have negative consequences.

risks.title: OFAC Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must comply with regulations from the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), and non-compliance could lead to fines and penalties.

risks.title: Future Legislation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to changes in laws and regulations, which could impact financial performance and business strategy.
